instruments.id: UT SB 100 (2023) - context only, not local evidence
instruments.title: School Gender Identity Policies
instruments.operative_summary: Each school and local board must ensure no policy shields a student's education record from the parent or interferes with a parent's access to information about the child. A school may not bar parent access to the record, and may not change a record about gender identity without written parental consent.
instruments.operative_quote: each school and each local governing board shall ensure that no policy or action of the school or LEA: (a) ... operates to shield a student's education record from the student's parent ... (3) ... a school or LEA may not: (a) prohibit a parent of a child from accessing the child's education record; or (b) without written parental consent make changes to a student's education record regarding a student's gender identity that does not conform with the student's sex.
instruments.rung_note: Parent access to records on request = rung 3. Clause 3(b) is a consent rule for RECORD changes, not for staff use of a name or pronouns, so it is near rung 5 but does not state it.
instruments.local_note: Marsha Judkins (now Provo Mayor, LOCAL_EXEC) voted YES as state Rep. (listed 'Judkins, M.'). This does NOT seat a local chair: (1) it was cast in a different seat, (2) local level is own words only, (3) No votes were 6 of 65 = 9.2%, under the 10% contested threshold.
